description: Seven persistent project tasks with no time anchor, under a stated project heading.
content:
Garage Work Project Tasks:
Patch holes in rear wall
Install bin shelves
Repair alcove light circuit
Install new alcove light
Install ladder racks
Tear out old workbench
Design new workbench
notes: Persistent actionable items with no time anchor are sprockets/task per CLASSIFY_SYSTEM. Seven near-identical phrasings make this the strongest test of whether dense lists survive without merging. parent_hint is asserted empty as of slice 5: 'Garage Work' is not in the supplied hierarchy context and CLASSIFY_SYSTEM forbids inventing a parent, so no parent is the only correct answer. The earlier version deliberately left parent_hint ungraded, which the section E audit flagged as a blind spot - and it was hiding a real defect. Slice 3a output shows all seven nodes carrying parent_hint 'Farm', a known parent but the wrong one: garage work filed under the farm. That is worse than invention, because an invented parent is visibly wrong in review while a plausible real one is not.
